problems.cut: Is any word or letter cut off by the edge of the picture, broken, or partly hidden by something?
problems.over: Does any text sit on top of a busy picture, shape or object, instead of on a plain background, so that the letters are harder to read?
problems.overlap: Does any text overlap other text, so that the letters touch or cross?
problems.glitch: Is there a visible rendering glitch in this picture: a dark band, a smear, a hole, a torn or doubled shape, or a stray object?

legible: Can you read every large word and number in this picture?
